//: This deploys apps/web ONLY — the React SPA. The API is NOT deployed here and
cannot be: it is a long-lived Fastify process with a SQLite file, local file
storage and open SSE streams. See DEPLOYMENT.md.
Set the Vercel project's Root Directory to the REPOSITORY ROOT, not apps/web.
apps/web/vite.config.ts aliases into ../../packages/*/src, so a scoped root
directory cannot resolve the workspace packages.

rewrites.//: Proxy the API so the SPA stays same-origin. This is what keeps BASE='/v1' in apps/web/src/lib/api.ts and the relative EventSource in routes/processing.tsx working unchanged, and keeps CORS out of the picture entirely. Replace the host below with your API deployment.
SPA fallback. Static files are served first, so this only catches client-side routes such as /records/:id and /verifications/:id/workspace.

headers.//: 14 §/11 §18 security posture at the static edge. The API sets its own CSP via helmet; this covers the documents the CDN serves.
11 §18: no public CDN scripts. Everything is bundled, so 'self' is sufficient.
headers.value: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'; base-uri 'self'

headers.//: ADR-008: there is no login. This application must never be indexed or cached by a shared proxy.
